takeaways: Sovanta's deep SAP-Qualtrics embedded analytics positioning in DACH financial services and manufacturing creates a clear co-opetition dynamic — SMT should differentiate by emphasizing banking-specific AI use cases and outcomes that go beyond SAP workflow integration, particularly in markets where SAP is not the dominant ERP.

commonFont's financial services Qualtrics focus makes them SMT's most direct US competitor — SMT should develop differentiated banking CX proof points around AI-driven journey orchestration and real-time experience intelligence that go beyond commonFont's implementation-focused positioning.
